loss.auxiliary: per crop: sum(S*softplus(-float32(logits)))/N_S for N_S>0; exact differentiable zero otherwise; mean over all four crops
loss.lambda_zero: exact bound A0 function bypass, no auxiliary arithmetic
loss.empty: retain empty crop in batch denominator four; no resampling, count floor above one, common activation gate, or implicit minimum target count
loss.gradient: lambda*S*(sigmoid(z)-1)/(4*N_S); target exterior and empty target zero; auxiliary logit L1<=lambda
loss.dose_caveat: B1/B2 own N_S changes shared-point weights as well as support; same lambda is not equal gradient dose
